action.action-desc: Ms. Mejia introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Ways and Means

form.official-title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to require the disclosure of return information to the Small Business Administration for the purposes of carrying out the Disaster Loan Program.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Fast Track Disaster Relief Act.

section.header: Disclosure of return information to Small Business Administration for purposes of carrying out Disaster Loan Program

subsection.text: Section 6103(l) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

paragraph.header: Disclosure of return information to Small Business Administration for purposes of carrying out Disaster Loan Program

subparagraph.text: The Secretary shall, upon written request from the Administrator of the Small Business Administration, disclose to officers and employees of the Small Business Administration return information of a taxpayer who is an applicant for a loan under section 7(b) of the Small Business Act.

Return information disclosed under subparagraph (A) may be used by officers and employees of the Small Business Administration only for the purposes of, and to the extent necessary in, determining a taxpayer’s eligibility for a loan under section 7(b) of the Small Business Act.

subsection.text: Section 6103(p)(4) of such Code is amended in the matter preceding subparagraph (A) and in subparagraph (F)(ii), by striking or (22), and inserting (22), or (23), each place it appears.
The amendments made by this section shall apply to disclosures made after the date of the enactment of this Act.
